text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "Clear introductory paragraph with thesis, distinct supporting body paragraphs, and a concluding summary.", "quality": "Paragraph Structure", "description": "Captures the logical organization of writing into clear, distinct paragraphs that group related ideas together."}, {"evidence": "Errors like \"I'm agree\" or \"bad wives [vibes]\" are minor, whereas Essay B contains severe run-on sentences and chaotic capitalization throughout.", "quality": "Grammatical Control", "description": "Captures the ability to use consistent mechanics, standard punctuation, proper capitalization, and correct sentence boundaries."}, {"evidence": "Words and phrases such as \"attracts failure\", \"essential in accomplishing goals\", \"confront everything\", and \"resiliency\".", "quality": "Academic Vocabulary", "description": "Captures the appropriate selection and accurate use of precise, mature vocabulary to convey ideas."}, {"evidence": "Effective use of transition phrases like \"For this reason\", \"Another reason why\", and \"To conclude\".", "quality": "Cohesive Devices", "description": "Captures the use of explicit transitional words and phrases to guide the reader smoothly between thoughts and paragraphs."}]}
